video_profile.composition: large centered headline, concise supporting explanation, simple medical illustrations/diagrams/tables, occasional photographic background with readable overlay cards
video_profile.backgrounds: warm cream/off-white for information slides; photographic backgrounds may be used when they improve clinical context
video_profile.typography: bold high-contrast headline typography; short labels; minimal text density; English and Arabic can coexist
video_profile.graphics: simple flat medical icons, diagrams, tables, arrows and highlighted values
video_profile.lower_caption_style: short centered caption/label near the lower portion of the frame, enclosed in a high-contrast box
video_profile.motion: subtle educational transitions; prioritize readability and stable framing over decorative motion
video_profile.information_density: one teaching point per visual beat

audio_profile.voice_character: clear, calm, confident medical-teaching narration; natural pacing; articulate terminology; no exaggerated acting
audio_profile.mixing: voice-forward, consistent loudness, clean pauses between teaching beats, no clipping

production_rules.master_template: keep the existing 6-scene architecture while adapting its visual skin and audio mix toward this reference
production_rules.audio_goal: match the reference loudness and perceived clarity, not the reference speaker identity
